$comment: Per-template default values for placeholders that do not come from art/bible/artbible.json. Copied verbatim from each template's comment block (test_gen.py checks every string still appears in the template file, so the two cannot drift). 'choices' pick a value from another placeholder's value. Read by tools/gen/genlib.py and tools/gen/lib/genlib.mjs. Order of precedence when rendering: bible context < these defaults < --var K=V.

symbol.txt.rigReadyLine: Rig-ready pose: every part clearly separated from the body, mouth closed and neutral, eyes open, no motion blur.
symbol.txt.negativeTiltLightNote: Key light from the upper left, slightly more from above.
